directory_policies.notes.4: Cost context: At least USD 104,820 at the 2026-27 research-master rate for the mandatory three full-time semesters. No final tuition ceiling is verified; fees, extra terms and future increases are excluded.

fact_summary: The 2026-27 bulletin gives USD 34,940 per fall/spring research-master semester and three required full-time semesters; continuing or summer enrollment adds tuition.
